summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AllianzIM U.S. Equity Buffer15 Uncapped Feb ETF (FEBU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in enhanced growth alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and uncapped gains on the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust over a one-year period. The actively managed fund holds options and collateral. FEBU was launched on Jan 31, 2025 and is issued by Allianz.
